relations.evidence: lāḍa ṣāna vinodāya ... kalyāṇa malla mahākavi viracite

notes: The colophon names no scribe, commissioner or owner of this copy. The only people named belong to the original text: the author Kalyāṇamalla, and Lāḍa Khān (written 'lāḍa ṣāna', i.e. Lāḍ Khān Lodī), the patron for whose entertainment (vinodāya) the author composed the work. He is listed with the role 'other' so he can be filtered out. 'śrīmal-' is read as the honorific śrīmat + Lāḍa. The year is taken as NS: VS 1005 (948 CE) would be impossible for a Nepali commentary on a 16th-century work, while NS 1005 gives about 1885 CE. The weekday after 'ro' (rojā/roja) is lost in a lacuna (+++++). A short passage after 'daśamasthala samāpta bhayo 10' is also illegible (++++++) and may have held names.
